## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup can be further improved by adding a veto gate that blocks entries when the VIX is below a certain threshold, indicating a low-volatility environment that may not be favorable for bearish trades.

## Mechanism

The veto gate will check the current VIX value and compare it to a threshold (e.g., 15). If the VIX is below the threshold, the gate will block the entry, and the trade will not be executed.
